assumptions: 196 mm is the orthogonal overall platter envelope, not a circular diameter; a 144 mm square has 203.65 mm diagonal.
All exact role profiles, arm centerline, relief, footprint and recognition decisions are specified in design-handoff.md.

build_plan.exit_criteria: One 196 by 196 by 12 mm connected solid; full 144 mm grid and two curled arms; isolated component print and visual checks pass.
Twelve role-and-side geometry variants produce 34 chessmen. Every isolated variant passes print and visual checks, followed by 35-part assembly inventory and signature verification.

components.duty: Support standard chess and distinguish all 64 spaces without color.
components.form: One solid 196 by 196 by 12 mm curled-arm platter supporting a 144 mm square level 8 by 8 field. Two 12 mm wide point-symmetric curled arms. Dark squares have 2 mm wide by 2 mm deep perimeter relief enclosing 14 mm level support plateaus.
components.interfaces: Each square supports one freely placed chessman; no hardware.
components.name: Spiral galaxy platter
components.placement: Bottom Z0, playing support Z12, square centers X and Y from -63 to 63 at 18 mm pitch.

components.duty: Retain exact standard chess king function; 1 starting copies.

components.interfaces: Flat base rests on the common board support plane; freely lift, slide, capture and replace.

concept.interaction: Play exact standard two-player chess on board with all white_king, white_queen, white_rook, white_bishop, white_knight, white_pawn, black_king, black_queen, black_rook, black_bishop, black_knight and black_pawn copies. Pick up, slide, capture and promote using all 34 chessmen; two queens are customary spares. In the ordinary endgame demonstration slide White Qh1 to h8 exactly 126 mm while White Kf6 and Black Kf8 remain fixed; Qh8 is checkmate, never king capture.
concept.print_stance: Each of the 35 physical parts flat-bottom down without supports; no hardware.
risks: CAD and physical checks have not been performed by this design handoff.
Small 18 mm squares require rendered crowded-position inspection; physical comfort and sliding friction remain untested.
concept.rules_difference: None. Theme never changes a legal choice, probability, state transition, result or scoring.
concept.signature_decision: Fixed elevated h-file before/after exact-state renders show the spiral-crown queen at near h1 then far h8, with both nuclei visible and 126 mm translation.
concept.summary: Chess — interacting-galaxies theme: tidal arms strip rival stellar structures until a galactic nucleus has no safe square.
concept.title: Tidal Crown

research.demo_proof: Qh8 attacks f8 along rank8. Queen excludes e8/g8; Kf6 excludes e7/f7/g7; Black has no other men and cannot capture h8. Initial position and queen path are legal.

design_changes: Independent review 1 rejected the concentric crenellated queen crown. Replaced that inventor-selected three-lobed styling with two visibly winding radial spiral arms; removed central peg, preserved 26 mm height and 14 mm base envelope. Nominal arm width 2.2 mm, minimum mutual clearance above 2 mm; polygon simplification 0.03 mm resolves coarse-render tessellation without changing required form.
research.novelty_claim: An unusual original combination; bounded search cannot prove universal novelty.
research.scope: Authorized revision, not a new Daydream. Research refresh validates frozen source facts and conventional inventory.
